data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Amazon Payment Services (Payfort) supporting Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Flutter interface for integrating Amazon Payment Services (Payfort). It allows processing payments, handling Apple Pay, generating signatures, and retrieving device identifiers on Android and iOS devices.
use_when: You need to integrate Amazon Payment Services (Payfort) into a Flutter application.
You require card payments and Apple Pay support via Payfort.
avoid_when: You are using a different payment gateway such as Stripe or Adyen.
You need web platform support (as only Android and iOS are documented).
strengths: Supports both Android and Apple Pay integrations.
Provides helper methods for device ID retrieval and signature generation.
weaknesses: Requires manual native configurations for both Android (Kotlin version, ProGuard rules) and iOS (deployment target).
Limited documentation outside of basic setup and method signatures.
data.setup_notes: Requires Android API 21+, Kotlin 1.5.0+, and ProGuard rule configuration. iOS requires setting a deployment target of 12.0 or above in the Podfile.

alternatives.name: adyen_checkout
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick this alternative if you are using Adyen instead of Amazon Payment Services as your payment gateway.

alternatives.name: flutter_stripe
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick this alternative if you are using Stripe instead of Amazon Payment Services as your payment gateway.
